text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A, D, and E after gains taught me that a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should follow a consistent plan aligned with my goals.","I should not keep a losing position just to avoid admitting a mistake; I should reassess it objectively and manage risk across the whole portfolio.","My account fluctuated despite no trades, and past price changes do not predict future ones. Checking often is not a reason to trade without a clear purpose."]}
